title: FreeRTOS differential campaign of 2026-09-27: the final campaign on the fixed core
status_note: The per-run results were not kept, so the campaign cannot be compared run for run. Superseded by results/freertos-campaign/2026-10-01_03386fd/, which repeats the same six commands as one suite (--suite sep2026) and reproduces the run counts, the per-set cycle totals and every per-run value that survives in the development log.

caveats: The six commands, their seeds and lengths, the per-set totals and the per-run values come from the development log of 2026-09-27. The campaign's own output directories (each with results.csv, results.json, summary.md and one sim.log per run) were in temporary storage that was lost on 2026-09-28.

The wall time of breaker2 (405 s) is the time between its start and end in the list of start and end times; its own wall-time line was not kept. Every wall time includes building the simulator models and the programs.

During the breaker command (at 22:30 EDT), sim/top.sv was edited (the initial values of the two variables of the +trace snoop, which prints only with +trace). Every breaker run used the simulator models built before the edit; breaker2 rebuilt them when it started, and the later commands used the rebuilt models. After the campaign the breaker set was run again on the rebuilt models: the log reports identical status and cycles in all 120 DUT runs, and in all 80 golden runs when compared with the earlier campaign of that evening (its breaker set ran from 19:13 to 19:26 EDT), which was itself identical to this one.
The figures were first quoted in README.md by commit 62b0407 (2026-09-28) and moved to docs/VERIFICATION.md by commit 499d488.

Correction (2026-10-01): this record was first filed as 2026-09-27_97ef211, the base commit of the measured tree, against the rule of results/README.md for work not yet committed; it was renamed to 2026-09-27_6b19d41, and the comparison with the re-run was run again after the rename.
